content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Goalpara District Copyist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Copyist. This is a purely contractual post announced by the Goalpara District administration.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Copyist in Goalpara District.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary (10+2) and possess a 6-month Diploma in Computer Application/IT with knowledge of software applications and proficiency in English and Assamese typing.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Copyist post?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 years and 40 years as of January 1, 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed pay of Rs. 9,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Copyist post?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date and time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the date of the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for September 10, 2026. Candidates should report between 09:30 AM and 12:30 PM.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Foreigners Tribunals, Goalpara. The exact venue address is usually mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original testimonials, two sets of self-attested Xerox copies of documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
